description: Source-backed Japan experiences with explicit plan, price, language and availability evidence.

tools.name: source_plan_date_price
tools.description: Fetch selected-date source price amounts by price-option ID; no participant total implied. Required: plan_id, date. Returns the DatePriceEnvelope.

tools.name: source_plan_detail
tools.description: Fetch source plan, operator, and price-option fields by exact plan ID and site language. Required: plan_id, lang_flag, url. Returns the PlanInfoEnvelope.

params.name: plan_id
params.description: Activity Japan plan ID, preserved as a string

params.name: lang_flag
params.description: Site language; it does not prove instructor language

params.name: url
params.description: Canonical Activity Japan plan URL for the selected site language

tools.name: source_plan_sessions
tools.description: Fetch source course IDs and statuses for one selected date; an observation, not a booking. Required: plan_id, selected_date. Returns the SessionsEnvelope.

tools.name: source_plan_stock_check
tools.description: Fetch the raw Activity Japan stock response for an exact plan, course, date, source status and count. Required: plan_id, c_id, date, status, count, type (pass 2 for the observed website mode). Returns StockCheckEnvelope. This raw tool does not validate the plan's party or age limits and does not reserve a place; use the experience check CLI command for a party-aware observation.

params.name: status
params.description: Source course status from the latest session observation

params.name: count
params.description: Raw basic-fee quantity; plan eligibility is not checked by this endpoint mirror

params.name: type
params.description: Source check mode observed in the plan page script

novel_features.name: Date-fit scan
novel_features.description: See observed session and option-price differences across up to seven itinerary dates.

novel_features.name: Constraint-aware shortlist
novel_features.description: Compare a few known plans against explicit age, party, time, price, and language constraints.

novel_features.name: Price-basis report
novel_features.description: See source option IDs, selected-date amounts, participant basis, and excluded extras.

novel_features.name: Language-surface check
novel_features.description: Check whether a plan ID is indexed in English, Japanese, or both.

novel_features.name: Handoff readiness
novel_features.description: Get a compact booking-handoff packet with known conditions and unresolved questions.
